items.exampleEn: The driver gaped in surprise as the bridge ahead rose to let a ship pass.
items.exampleZh: 前方的橋升起讓船通過時，那位駕駛驚訝得目瞪口呆。
items.glossZh: 目瞪口呆地看；張開、裂開

items.exampleEn: At the end of the meeting, Ken gave a quick roundup of what we had agreed.
items.exampleZh: 會議最後，Ken 把我們達成的共識快速做了個總整理。

items.exampleEn: He chiseled his name into the old wooden door.
items.exampleZh: 他把自己的名字刻在那扇舊木門上。

items.exampleEn: Our two farms adjoin each other along the river.
items.exampleZh: 我們兩家的農場沿著河流彼此相鄰。

items.exampleEn: It took me ten minutes to untangle the dog's leash.
items.exampleZh: 我花了十分鐘才把狗的牽繩解開。

items.exampleEn: Schools were told to keep classrooms well ventilated.
items.exampleZh: 學校被要求讓教室保持通風良好。

items.exampleEn: Stop dithering and choose a dessert!
items.exampleZh: 別再猶豫了，快選一樣甜點吧！

items.sentenceEn: Can you help me untangle this necklace before we go out?
items.sentenceZh: 出門前你可以幫我把這條項鍊解開嗎？

items.audioEn: Here is our morning news roundup: traffic is heavy downtown, and rain is expected this afternoon.
items.audioZh: 以下是早晨新聞摘要：市中心交通壅塞，預計今天下午會下雨。
items.questionZh: 根據這段新聞摘要，今天下午的天氣如何？
options: It will be sunny and very warm
Strong winds will close the roads

items.sentenceEn: The manager dithered over the decision until the deadline had passed.
items.sentenceZh: 經理對這個決定猶豫不決，直到期限都過了。

items.sentenceEn: We gaped at the size of the bill.
items.sentenceZh: 我們看到帳單的金額，都目瞪口呆。

items.stemEn: Please open the windows to ____ the room after painting it.
items.stemZh: 油漆完之後，請打開窗戶讓房間通風。

items.stemEn: Our office ____ a busy cafe, so it always smells of fresh coffee.
items.stemZh: 我們的辦公室緊鄰一家熱鬧的咖啡館，所以總是聞得到新鮮咖啡的香味。

items.passageEn: Ms. Lin runs a small stone-carving studio that adjoins her house. Because carving fills the air with fine dust, she keeps two large fans running to ventilate the room. Last month, a hotel asked her to chisel a lion for its entrance. She dithered for weeks, worried that the job was too big for one person, but she finally said yes. The work required great precision, and visitors often gaped at the half-finished lion through her window. When a local radio station included her in its weekly arts roundup, even more people came to watch. Her only complaint was the mess of power cables she had to untangle every morning.
items.passageZh: 林小姐經營一間小小的石雕工作室，就緊鄰著她家。因為雕刻會讓空氣充滿細小的粉塵，她總是開著兩台大電扇讓室內通風。上個月，一家飯店請她為大門入口雕一頭獅子。她猶豫了好幾個星期，擔心這份工作對一個人來說太大，但最後還是答應了。這項工作需要非常精確，來訪的人常隔著窗戶，目瞪口呆地看著那頭還沒完成的獅子。當地一家電台把她列入每週的藝文綜合報導後，來看的人更多了。她唯一的抱怨，是每天早上都得把一團亂的電線解開。

questions.questionZh: 林小姐為什麼猶豫了好幾個星期？
options: 擔心工作量太大，一個人做不完
飯店給的酬勞比她平常收的低很多
不確定自己有沒有時間去飯店現場看

questions.questionZh: 後來為什麼有更多人來看她工作？
options: 她在網路上分享了雕刻的過程影片
飯店在門口貼出了她的作品照片
她上了電台的藝文報導
她把工作室搬到了熱鬧的大街上

items.promptZh: 這位藝術家花了三年，從一塊大理石雕出這座雕像。
referenceEn: The artist spent three years chiseling this statue out of a block of marble.
It took the artist three years to chisel this statue from a piece of marble.
rubricZh: 「雕出」用 chisel，例如 chisel this statue out of marble、chisel…from a piece of marble 等
「花了三年」可寫，例如 spent three years＋V-ing、It took…three years to 等

items.promptZh: 這個網站每週五會用電子郵件寄出一週科技新聞的摘要。
referenceEn: Every Friday, this website sends out an email with a roundup of the week's technology news.
This website sends readers a weekly roundup of technology news by email every Friday.
rubricZh: 「摘要」用 roundup（例如 a roundup of the week's technology news 等）
「用電子郵件寄出」可寫，例如 sends out an email with…、sends…by email 等
說的是固定的習慣，時態配合內容
